# Excalidraw Element Tests

These tests cover various aspects of the Excalidraw element library, including creating and selecting rectangles, bounding calculations, collision detection, cropping elements, and more.

## Overview

This layer focuses on testing the core elements and functionalities of the Excalidraw library. It includes tests for creating and selecting elements, collision detection, bounding calculations, and more.

## Responsibilities

- **Element Creation and Selection**: Tests for creating and selecting different types of elements like rectangles, flowcharts, and sticky notes.
